heading: Answer engine optimization software for marketing teams
description: Track where AI search mentions your brand, see which sources it cites, and measure what changes after you update your pages.
intro: See how AI search describes your brand and which pages its answers cite. Use the evidence to decide what to update on your website.

sections.title: Measure AI visibility
sections.text: Track mentions, citations, competitors, recommendations, and answer accuracy across a tracked set of buyer questions. Supported engines include ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Claude, with coverage depending on your plan.

sections.title: Diagnose the answer gap
sections.text: Use Deep Analysis to examine the answers and citations for a buyer question. Run a Content Audit on the page that could address the gap.

link.label: See a sample content audit report

sections.title: Draft changes your team can review
sections.text: Use Corporate Context, your approved facts and claims, to ground briefs and drafts. Your team reviews and publishes the changes.

sections.title: Verify what moved
sections.text: Measure the same buyer questions before and after publishing. Compare recommendations, citations, and answer accuracy against your baseline.

link.label: Read the Cornelis Networks case study

tools.label: Free ChatGPT visibility tracker
